answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a hardware-rooted clock whose drift, calibrated against a Rubidium-87 optical lattice reference, is as unique as a mineral pigment and costly to replicate. Sybil wallets must post a copper-denominated bond locked to that clock's attested phase history, so forged identities erode like soluble karst rather than proliferate. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
